ops.title: Self-bootstrap live in 9.15.0 — smoke findings + claude-install caveat
ops.body:
The pack scaffold + marketplace self-bootstrap wave shipped in **capt-hook 9.15.0** (concurrent session tagged `v9.15.0` at `c651be50`, bundling my wave `1aea4c64…2c618cae` + their scratch-writes/rewrite-command work). Verified the published wheel contains `bootstrap.py`, `contract.py`, `scaffold.py`, the starter template, and the cli scaffold/bootstrap commands, including the `-I` isolation fix.

**Live smoke (published 9.15.0 attach, isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR + CAPTAIN_HOOK_STATE_DIR, no marketplace):** the `BOOTSTRAP_NOTICE` fired on stdout, the detached worker spawned and ran `claude plugin marketplace add yasyf/captain-hook` (idempotent — "already declared in user settings") then `claude plugin install captain-hook@captain-hook`, the attempt marker was written (hourly cooldown), and attach returned instantly (worker fully detached — session never blocked).

**Caveat worth watching:** in the smoke test `claude plugin install captain-hook@captain-hook` **hit the worker's 300s timeout** (`subprocess.run(..., timeout=300)` → TimeoutExpired, logged loud). Root cause was test-environment: my machine already declares captain-hook, so the scratch marketplace-add was a no-op and never cloned into the isolated config, leaving `install` nothing to resolve. On a clean consumer machine the add actually clones, and on CC ≥2.1.117 (this box is 2.1.207) the marketplace-add ALONE auto-resolves the dependency — the explicit install is belt-and-suspenders. The safety design held regardless: detached worker + 300s timeout + marker cooldown mean a hung/failed install never blocks the session and re-tries at most hourly, and the documented fallback (`claude plugin marketplace add yasyf/captain-hook`, troubleshooting.qmd) resolves a `dependency-unsatisfied` plugin on the spot. Open question for a future clean-machine test: does `claude plugin install` complete non-interactively under DEVNULL stdin, or should the worker drop the explicit install and rely on marketplace-add's auto-resolve?
